amendments.before: Ne ondrǣdað ēow nānes ðinges, ne ofðynce ēow ðæt gē mē on ðis rīce sealdon; sōðlice God sęnde mē for ēowre ðearfe tō Egypta lande.
amendments.after: Ne ondrǣdað ēow nānes ðinges, ne ofðynce ēow ðæt gē mē on ðis rīce sealdon; sōðlice God sęnde mē for ēowerre ðearfe tō Egypta lande.
amendments.reason: The selected for+benefit phrase takes dative. Use actual prior feminine dative singular possessive ēowerre, not accusative ēowre relabelled as a dative. No unattested contracted variant is added; positions and verbs are unchanged.
